features: SKULLSAINTS Onyx is powered by the J6412

Pre-installed with 8GB DDR4 RAM and 256GB SSD storage, the SKULLSAINTS Onyx offers high-speed performance and fast data access. The storage is also expandable up to 2TB, giving you plenty of room for your files, applications, and games. This makes it an ideal mini computer for a variety of uses, from office work to high-performance gaming.

Connectivity is a key feature of this mini PC, with 4 x 2.5G i226 LAN ports, WiFi 6, and Bluetooth 5.0 ensuring ultra-fast networking and seamless wireless connections. Whether you’re streaming content, gaming, or setting up a home network, this gaming mini PC provides stable and fast connections.

Durability and Versatility: Designed for extreme conditions, this small PC withstands temperatures from -20°C to 60°C and 90% humidity at 40°C, making it ideal for industrial applications, ensuring reliability as a mini desktop

With VESA mount support, the SKULLSAINTS Onyx can be easily attached to the back of a monitor, freeing up desk space. Its rugged design and ability to operate in a wide range of temperatures make it a durable solution for industrial mini PCs or any setting where reliability is key. The system is ideal for small PC setups, mini desktops, or networking applications.
